value.name: File VAT EC Sales List
value.description:
Overview

File an EU VAT Recapitulative Statement to give details on sales to EU countries for a specific filing period (tax period). 

Message structure and content will be validated, summary of typical responses:

  • 200 - OK if all validations are passed. When submitting returns or reports 200 - OK response containing a unique identifier and an accepted timestamp confirms that Finnish Tax Administration has received the information.
  • 400 - Bad Request with error code and message from the service. Caller must review and correct the input and send it again. Common error codes:
    • 1005 - Error in json structure or invalid value in a field
    • 1040 - Caller does not have access to the data - check if Suomi.fi authorization is required
  • 500 - Internal Server Error, client certificate of the caller might not yet been set up or temporary issue or outage in the system, endpoint can be called again later.

More information about filing a recapitulative statement at Vero.fi:

EU VAT Recapitulative Statement - vero.fi

Please note:

  • The first statement of a month cannot contain customers with no sales (i.e. all sales values are zero).
  • You can file multiple statements for a specific month. This will have one or both of the following effects depending on what was initially reported:
    • Replaces the sales volumes to the customer, if that customer has already been reported for that month
    • Adds a new customer to the statement, if that customer has not yet been reported for that month 
  • When sending a correction to previously submitted information, you must submit a full replacement of what had been specifically reported for that particular customer (for example, you cannot report just a new sales of services value, but must give all the correct information regarding that customer). There is no need to resend the customers where specific reporting has been correct.
  • If you had reported some values for a wrong month, you must file a statement, where the information is put right (for example, if there were no sales, enter a zero). You must file your statement again for the month where the values actually relate to. 
  • If you want to "delete" previously reported information regarding a specific customer, you must file a new statement for the same customer for the month where the error happened and enter the sales values as zeros. 
  • The seller must be registered for VAT for at least one day in the month for which the statement is being filed.
  • Suomi.fi authorization is required with role "Veroasioiden hoito" or "Verotukseen liittyvien tietojen ilmoittaminen, päivittäminen ja hakeminen rajapinnan kautta" when processing other than own data.

Test data

The test URL will provide following static calculated responses in addition to input validation errors:
 

Parameters Response
Any valid request body except the one below 200 - OK 

{
    "UniqueIdentifier": "Gateway Key",
    "AcceptedTimestamp": "Current time"
}
BusinessId = "8763054-9"  400 - Bad request

{
    "ErrorCode": "1103",
    "ErrorText": "Invalid Business Id."
}
Invalid input 400 - Bad request with error details

  • Production version

value.name: File VAT Return v2
value.description:
Overview

File a VAT return with the given values for specific filing period (tax period). Before filing a return, use GetVatPeriods endpoint to get list of valid filing periods. Use period specific CustomsComparisonDataOnImportsOfGoods information from GetVatPeriods endpoint on the return when necessary.

Message structure and content will be validated, summary of typical responses:​

  • 200 – OK if all validations are passed. When submitting returns or reports 200 – OK response containing a unique identifier and an accepted timestamp confirms that Finnish Tax Administration has received the information.​
  • 400 – Bad Request with error code and message from the service. Caller must review and correct the input and send it again. Common error codes:​
    • 1005 – Error in json structure or invalid value in a field​

    • 1040 – Caller does not have access to the data – check if Suomi.fi authorization is required​

  • 500 – Internal Server Error, client certificate of the caller might not yet been set up or temporary issue or outage in the system, endpoint can be called again later.​

More information about VAT filing and payment at Vero.fi:

  • Filing and payment - vero.fi

Please note:


  • The medium VAT rate 14% changes to 13.5% on 01.01.2026.

  • VAT on cash basis and VAT relief information cannot be reported for filing periods that start on the year 2025 or later. The tax period 31.12.2024 is the last filing period for which the VAT on cash basis and VAT relief information can be reported.

  • The version 2 of the API released on 18.11.2024 will replace the current version (v1) on 01.01.2025. The VAT rate field names are generic in the version 2:
    • VATDetails.VATOnDomesticSalesByTaxRate.24Percent (v1) → VATDetails.VATOnDomesticSalesByTaxRate.HighVATRate (v2)
    • VATDetails.VATOnDomesticSalesByTaxRate.14Percent (v1) → VATDetails.VATOnDomesticSalesByTaxRate.MediumVATRate (v2)
    • VATDetails.VATOnDomesticSalesByTaxRate.10Percent (v1) → VATDetails.VATOnDomesticSalesByTaxRate.LowVATRate (v2)

  • The general VAT rate changed on 01.09.2024. Both 24% and 25.5% VAT sales are reported in the "VATDetails.VATOnDomesticSalesByTaxRate.HighVATRate" field.

  • VAT on purchases of construction services and scrap metal is reported in accordance with the general VAT rate.

    • Use ReplacementReturn and ReplacementReason in the body when sending a correction to previously filed return. Every return after the first one needs to be a ReplacementReturn. 
    • Only 200 - OK response indicates an accepted return. Failing to file the report in time may lead to penalty fees.
    • VATOnPurchasesAndImports require the corresponding purchase to be filed under SalesPurchasesImports object. 
    • FilingPeriods outside the adjustment period will not be accepted. GetVATPeriod endpoint returns expired status if a return is outside of the adjustment period.
    • Suomi.fi authorization is required with role "Veroasioiden hoito" or "Verotukseen liittyvien tietojen ilmoittaminen, päivittäminen ja hakeminen rajapinnan kautta" when requesting other than own data.

    Valid ReplacementReason values:

    • Calculation error = CLC
    • Legal practice = LGL
    • Tax audit guidance = TXA
    • Law interpretation = LAW

    Valid VATRelief Reason values:

    • Final accounting period of the tax year = 1
    • Final quarter of the calendar year = 2
    • VAT role is ending this tax period = 3
    • Annual filer = 4
    • Requesting because reporting VAT relief will end on 31.12.2024. This is not the last tax period of my accounting period. Value (5) can only be selected on tax period 31.12.2024. = 5

    Amount of VAT relief and tax payable or tax that qualifies for refund is calculated based on reported values. The Tax Administration will not necessarily approve your return as it is and may change or may already have changed the return details. If the Tax Administration deviates from the details you filed, you will receive a separate decision letter that can be retrieved using ListLetters and GetLetter API endpoints or viewed manually in MyTax. If necessary, you can however submit a replacement return at any stage.

    Test data

    The test URL will provide following static calculated responses in addition to input validation errors:

     

    Parameters Response

     

     

    Any valid request body except ones below

    200 - OK 

    {

        "UniqueIdentifier": "Gateway Key",

        "AcceptedTimestamp": "Current time"

    }

     

     

     

    BusinessId = "8763054-9" 

    400 - Bad request

    {

        "ErrorCode": "1103",

        "ErrorText": "Invalid Business Id."

    }
    Invalid input 400 - Bad request with error details

      • Medium VAT rate changes as of 01.01.2026

    2024-06-05

      • General VAT rate changes as of 01.09.2024

      • Release of the new version (v2) of the API on 18.11.2024 and deactivation of the current version (v1) on 01.01.2025.

value.name: Get Filed VAT Return v2
value.description:
Overview

Get the filed VAT return for the chosen tax period.

Message structure and content will be validated, summary of typical responses:

  • 200 – OK if all validations are passed. When submitting returns or reports 200 – OK response containing a unique identifier and an accepted timestamp confirms that Finnish Tax Administration has received the information.
  • 400 – Bad Request with error code and message from the service. Caller must review and correct the input and send it again. Common error codes:
    • 1005 – Error in json structure or invalid value in a field
    • 1040 – Caller does not have access to the data - check if Suomi.fi authorization is required
  • 500 – Internal Server Error, client certificate of the caller might not yet been set up or temporary issue or outage in the system, endpoint can be called again later.

More information about VAT filing and payment at Vero.fi:

  • https://www.vero.fi/en/businesses-and-corporations/taxes-and-charges/vat/when-to-file-and-pay/Filing and payment - vero.fi

Please note:


  • The medium VAT rate 14% changes to 13.5% on 01.01.2026.

  • VAT on cash basis and VAT relief information cannot be reported for filing periods that start on the year 2025 or later. The tax period 31.12.2024 is the last filing period for which the VAT on cash basis and VAT relief information can be reported.

  • The version 2 of the API released on 18.11.2024 will replace the current version (v1) on 01.01.2025. The VAT rate field names are generic in the version 2:

    • VATOnDomesticSales.24Percent (v1) → VATOnDomesticSales.HighVATRate (v2)
    • VATOnDomesticSales.14Percent (v1) → VATOnDomesticSales.MediumVATRate (v2)
    • VATOnDomesticSales.10Percent (v1) → VATOnDomesticSales.LowVATRate (v2)
  • The general VAT rate changed on 01.09.2024. Both 24% and 25.5% VAT sales are returned in the "VATOnDomesticSales.HighVATRate" field for the tax periods 01.09.–31.12.2024.
    • Only the values of the latest return are shown. If a return is being processed the values of the last accepted return are shown. If no return has been accepted yet no values are returned.
    • If a new return was recently filed it might not immediately be returned through the API.
    • If the return status is 'Estimated' only Status, SubmittedDate and TaxPayableOrNegativeTaxThatQualifiesForRefund fields are returned.
    • If the return status is 'Missing' no other fields will be returned.
    • Suomi.fi authorization is required with role "Veroasioiden hoito" or "Verotukseen liittyvien tietojen ilmoittaminen, päivittäminen ja hakeminen rajapinnan kautta" when requesting other than own data.

value.name: Get VAT Periods
value.description:
Overview

Before filing a return get the VAT filing periods of the customer for the chosen year with this API endpoint. In general, a return must be filed to each filing period (also called tax period). Each filing period is identified with a date which is usually last day of filing period.

  • 200 - OK if all validations are passed. When submitting returns or reports 200 - OK response containing a unique identifier and an accepted timestamp confirms that Finnish Tax Administration has received the information.​
  • 400 - Bad Request with error code and message from the service. Caller must review and correct the input and send it again. Common error codes:​
    • 1005 - Error in json structure or invalid value in a field​

    • 1040 - Caller does not have access to the data - check if Suomi.fi authorization is required​

  • 500 - Internal Server Error, client certificate of the caller might not yet been set up or temporary issue or outage in the system, endpoint can be called again later.​

More information about VAT filing and payment at Vero.fi:

  • Filing and payment - vero.fi

Please note:

  • The current year's info is only returned til currently active period (month/quarter/year, depending on the filing frequency).
  • FilingStatus Expired means the filing period is outside the adjustment period. 
  • If no periods are found an empty message is returned. 
  • CustomsComparisonDataOnImportsOfGoods contains tax period specific import information from Customs that should be included in the VAT return.
  • Suomi.fi authorization is required with role "Veroasioiden hoito" or "Verotukseen liittyvien tietojen ilmoittaminen, päivittäminen ja hakeminen rajapinnan kautta" when requesting other than own data.
